baseline.reason: Greenfield repository. No canonical docs existed prior to this run and no doc carried a last_synced_commit, so there is no prior baseline to diff against. All CDR indexes were empty (0 lines in every .cdr/index/*.jsonl).

summary: init mode: all canonical documentation created from scratch at commit 438138573aa69c26727651b368e056262908bc69. Zero drift by construction - there is no application source code in the repository, so no doc can contradict an implementation. Every doc is derived solely from docs/specs/common-platform-spec.md and docs/specs/video-agent-prd.md, both of which were verified against their origin PDFs (Guidelines.pdf, Video-Agent.pdf) during this run and found faithful.

inputs.note: Governs wherever the PRD is silent. Verified against Guidelines.pdf.

invariants.statement: Never leave a canonical doc half-written
invariants.evidence: All 13 canonical docs written whole in a single pass; each verified for front-matter stamp, complete section set and resolvable internal links.

open_questions.tension: PRD 'capped at 2 attempts' does not say whether the initial generation counts.
open_questions.resolution: D-01 - 2 repair attempts after the initial generation (max 3 per shot).

open_questions.tension: PRD states 0.75 only as a success-metric threshold ('>= 85% of jobs'), not as a QC gate.
open_questions.resolution: D-39 - 0.75 is the acceptance gate; shots that exhaust repairs below it still ship flagged, which is why the fleet target is 85% rather than 100%.

open_questions.tension: PRD header says 'four 10-second shots'; the method says only 'summing to exactly 40s'.
open_questions.resolution: D-03 - v1 fixes 10s per beat; duration_s field exists so unequal beats are a config change.

open_questions.tension: CPS says LiteLLM is 'single egress for every model call'; LiteLLM does not front video generation APIs.
open_questions.resolution: D-06 - LiteLLM is the single egress for every LLM call; video uses a parallel capability registry under the same failure policy and the same alias-only rule.

open_questions.tension: CPS 'same failure signature twice -> stop immediately' contradicts a repair loop that by construction retries the same shot.
open_questions.resolution: D-02 + D-18 - signatures are scoped (shot vs job) and include a score band.

open_questions.tension: CPS mandates a vector store and the realtime-voice / embed-default aliases; Video Agent v1 has no consumer for any of them.

next_actions: Product confirmation on open questions A1, A2 and A4.
Run CDR documentation in sync mode once the first application code lands; regenerate only drifted sections.
